metadata.description: End-to-end change-shipping automation — worktree isolation, engineer implementation, commit, push, PR creation, CI monitoring, merge, and cleanup. Zero manual steps from task to merge.

plugins.name: supera
plugins.description: End-to-end change-shipping toolkit: start (bootstrap repo config), ship (worktree → implement → commit → push → PR → hand off to pr-watch), pr-watch (monitor CI → fix failures → merge → cleanup). Driven by a per-repo .claude/supera.json config.
